Author: OmegaJackie
Name: Relicable
Changelog:
1.5.9.7 - everything since 1.5.5.8. No access code any more, and the base relic finishes its own work:

Access: the Early Alpha access code is gone. Relicable runs for anyone who installs it.

Braves: the material quests are handled end to end. Every quest that can be taken is accepted in one sweep ("Wherefore Art Thou, Zodiac" first, then nearest first), their materials are pulled off your retainers, and the hand-over window is actually pressed and checked rather than assumed. A finished quest stays finished instead of being re-accepted, a finished stage stops walking back to Papana, and a second relic no longer skips Atma through Nexus to run Braves dungeons. New Skip Step on the main window for a Braves quest step you have already handled yourself.

Turn-ins: a conversation ending no longer counts as a turn-in. One that cannot succeed is tried once rather than three times, the stop message names what is missing, and the final delivery is driven and verified like the rest.

Weapons: the beastman hunt equips the unfinished relic rather than whichever one it found first, a finished relic in the armoury no longer shuts down the stage for the one you are building, an Arcanist counts as a Summoner while that relic quest is open, and the broken-weapon coffers are found as game objects rather than wiki coordinates.

Novus: filling the Sphere Scroll takes it to Jalzahn and finishes the stage, and the Alexandrite farm stops when there is nothing left to spend it on.

Avoidance: BossMod Reborn AoE avoidance only ever survived the first pull of each step - it now stays on, its checkbox works, and the preset boxes are dropdowns of the presets you actually have.

Also: "Relics to build" and "Repeat completed stages" settings, auto-discard only ever touches enemy drops (it had been taking crafting materials), a stopped run always says why, and the Limsa market board trip stops in front of the board instead of inside it.
Punchline: Automate the ARR Zodiac relic line
Description:
Data-driven automation engine for the ARR Zodiac relic line (A Relic Reborn through Zodiac Zeta). It plans and drives the stage objectives - Atma FATE farming, Animus book leves and dungeons, Novus materia/scroll planning, Nexus light farming, and the Jalzahn/Gerolt upgrade turn-ins - by orchestrating other plugins over IPC rather than replacing them.

Requires these companion plugins, installed and working: vnavmesh (movement), BossMod Reborn, Rotation Solver Reborn or Wrath Combo (combat), Lifestream (aetheryte travel), TextAdvance (dialogue), and AutoDuty (dungeons). The Dependencies tab in /relic config shows live status for each.

USE AT YOUR OWN RISK: automating movement and combat is botting under the FINAL FANTASY XIV User Agreement, and Square Enix suspends and terminates accounts for it. The risk is highest for the open-world stages (Atma, Animus, Nexus, Zeta), which run in shared content where other players can observe and report you. Neither this plugin nor its authors can reduce that risk or protect you from it.

This software takes control of your character for long unattended sessions. It is incomplete, it has rough edges, and stages will occasionally stall and need manual help. Do not run it unattended if that is not acceptable to you. Bug reports should include /xllog output with 'Enable debug log' turned on in /relic config.
